evidence.why: State 5 retains armed setup and its collision callback returns to attachment state 4.
State 1 instead supplies the ordinary state-0 landing destination.

facts.rationale: Distinguishes armed state-5 reattachment from state-1 unarmed landing and resolves the rendered Fall_Coll collision without changing the supported state-1 name. This is a semantic name, not a recovered original identifier.

evidence.why: Pre-subtraction sign/magnitude tests and absence of a post-subtraction clamp.

facts.rationale: Preserves the falling role while correcting a potentially misleading hard maximum-speed interpretation.
facts.value: Runs state-1 falling physics by forwarding the item's configured fall acceleration and maximum-speed threshold to it_80272860. The shared helper uses velocity/acceleration sign and current speed magnitude to decide whether to subtract acceleration; it does not clamp the resulting velocity, so an update may cross the threshold.

evidence.why: Support-loss entry, falling physics and reattachment callback.

facts.rationale: Replaces the ambiguous and incorrect 'fifth internal motion state' ordinal with the numeric ID and useful detached-armed role.
facts.value: Realizes the Motion-Sensor Bomb's falling movement while it remains armed after losing its supporting terrain. This is motion-state ID 5, the sixth row of the zero-based state table, and its paired collision callback can return the bomb to attached state 4.

evidence.why: Offset priority, sound call and surrounding arming.
Wall, floor and ceiling query meanings.

facts.rationale: Corrects the floor-versus-ceiling interpretation and includes the actual audio role without treating this helper as the entire arming transition.
facts.value: Implements the placement-adjustment and sound substep of Motion-Sensor Bomb attachment. Floor contact leaves position unchanged by this helper; otherwise ceiling contact adds the scaled ECB height to Y, while wall query results 8 and 4 respectively add or subtract special attribute x4 from X. Surrounding state setup installs touch activation and marks the bomb armed.

evidence.why: SFX, pan and volume signature and audio calls.

facts.rationale: Canonical Item_8026AE84 calls the audio subsystem; the previous visual-color explanation was factually wrong.
facts.value: Finalizes the grounded attachment substep by setting xDCE_flag.b3, applying contact-dependent position offsets, and playing SFX 243 with pan 127 and volume 64. Floor contact bypasses offsets; otherwise ceiling contact adds scl * (attrs->x8.top - attrs->x8.bottom) to Y, and wall results 8 or 4 add or subtract attrs->x4 from X. The fixed final arguments are audio parameters, not color channels.

evidence.why: Ground guard and state-4/state-5 call order.
Sound rather than color side effect.

facts.rationale: Retains the shared-setup lifetime distinction while removing the incorrect visual-configuration claim and making the ground/air setter effects explicit.
facts.value: Performs no motion-state transition itself. Shared armed setup invokes it only when ground_or_air is GA_Ground, then continues with touched-callback installation, interaction/hitbox setup and the armed-history bit write. State-4 entry first sets ground classification, so it executes this placement-and-sound substep; state-5 entry first sets air classification, so it skips it and subsequently clears xDCE_flag.b3.

facts.rationale: Corrects the completion mechanism while preserving local guards and the distinction between direct calls and duplicated inline sequences.
facts.value: Unconditionally selects motion state 6 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE and runs it_80290614. Its external-dispatch caller requires clear x13 and state 4 or 5. Damage-received in states 4/5 and the installed touched callback execute equivalent transition-and-setup sequences directly. Setup initializes xD44_lifeTimer from shared item data; subsequent state-6 animation callbacks decrement that timer and report completion at zero or below, rather than testing visual animation end.

evidence.why: Packed attack field and owner-dependent data initialization.

facts.rationale: Separates packed attack data and positional count/configuration from effect identifiers using canonical callee bodies.
facts.value: Derives Item and root HSD_JObj from the supplied object, hides the model hierarchy, and forwards the object through shared setup helpers. it_8027518C initializes xD44_lifeTimer and shared flags. The value 0x440061 passed to it_8027B288 is packed attack bookkeeping stored in Item.xD90, with associated owner attack data copied or initialized; it_8027B564 conditionally records that information for a fighter owner. Item.pos is copied to a local Vec and passed to lb_800119DC with 120, 1.0f, 0.02f and 1.0471976f. That helper copies the position and stores 120 as unk_count0 in its configuration record, not as an effect identifier. Remaining item/effect/hitbox helpers run afterward; the function returns void.

evidence.why: Transition, one-shot setup and separate animation callback.
Positional configuration rather than effect-ID dispatch.

facts.rationale: Corrects the claimed visual effect numbered 120 and distinguishes setup from the timer-based per-frame completion phase.
facts.value: Performs one-shot detonation setup after callers select state 6: hides the model, initializes shared lifetime processing, updates packed attack bookkeeping and owner-related attack records, configures a position-based effect through lb_800119DC, and runs the remaining item/effect/hitbox helpers. The positional call's argument 120 is a count field, not a visual-effect ID. Subsequent completion is handled by the separate state-6 lifetime callback.

evidence.why: Setup call order, lifetime wrapper and armed damage path.
Actual delegated timer mutation and expiration test.

facts.rationale: Makes the delegated timer mutation explicit and replaces the incorrect animation-completion interpretation.
facts.value: Runs after state-6 selection and contains no local branch or motion-state change. It nevertheless initializes the explosion lifetime through it_8027518C, which sets xD44_lifeTimer from shared field xF8 and sets shared flags. Armed damage-received and touched paths invoke the same transition-then-setup sequence. Later itMsbomb_UnkMotion6_Anim calls it_802751D8, which decrements the lifetime and returns true at zero or below; completion is independent of a visual animation-end test.

evidence.why: Callback installation shared by armed attachment and falling.

facts.rationale: Preserves the unguarded touch path and armed-falling lifetime while correcting the completion mechanism.
facts.value: Installed in Item.touched by shared armed setup used for states 4 and 5. On invocation it unconditionally selects state 6 with ITEM_ANIM_UPDATE, runs detonation setup and returns false; it has no local state or x13 guard. Setup initializes the shared explosion lifetime, and subsequent state-6 animation callbacks decrement that timer and report expiration at zero or below rather than testing visual animation completion.
